page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred dedication list; no margin notes; ornamental rule at head above the text; closing signature line at foot.

main_text.l: Reverendis, Clarißimis, Pietate Omnigena ac multijuga
Eruditione Conspicuis Viris,
Dn. ABRAHAMO de LOSEA, Ecclesiæ Bernensis Pastor
indefesso, Agnato suo ac Patrono ad aras usq; colendo.
Dn. DAVIDI ALBINO, Philosophiæ Professori solidissimæ
Acutissimo, Collegij in Pædagogio Inspectori fidelissimo, stu-
diorum suorum Promotori indefinenter observando.
Dn. SAMUELI HENZIO, Linguæ Græcæ ac Philosophiæ
Practicæ Professori sagacissimo, Agnato suo itidem debitæ ob-
servantiæ cultu jugiter prosequendo.
Nec Non
Gravitate, Prudentiâ ac multarum rerum peritiâ
Spectatissimis Viris,
Dn. GUILIELMO BERSETH, apud Rhætos inalpinos
Chiliarchiâ olim, ac duplici nuper Præfectura in Erlach ac
Oberhofen strenuè defuncto, Mecœnati suo summô
Obsequiô colendo.
Dn. JOH. RODOLPHO ZEENDERO, Oeconomiâ
Zophingensi laudatissimè defuncto, Patrono suo æviternùm
Venerando.
Dn. GEORGIO STEINEGGERO, Consuli Zophin-
gensi prudentissimo, Fautori suo Benevolentissimo, debitè
observando.
Quin Etiam
Dn. CHRISTIANO CHAMBRINO, Pastori Zophin-
gensium pervigili, Fautori suo ac Promotori omni observan-
tiæ genere devenerando.
Dn. PETRO HUBERO, Illustris Bernatum Metropolis
Civi Meritissimo, Hospiti suo perpetim amando, colendo.
Dn. ADAMO SALCHLINO, Hypodidascalo Scholæ Ca-
strovillanæ cordato, fratri suo Germano in seculorum myria-
des suspiciendo ac fraterno amore prosequendo.

l.i: Hasce studiorum suorum primitias in debitæ Observ. testeram
quâ par est Humanitate, decerpit, dicat ac consecrat,

main_text.l: J-
oh. Rodolphus Salchlinus, Resp.

page.notes: Small show-through of the reverse page is visible in the middle and at right; ignored. Some letters in the dedication lines are faint at the right edge (e.g. "Obsequiô", "Venerando") and were read with care; ornamental rule at head is not text. The ligature-like "Dn." abbreviations are rendered in italics as a best reading of their small-capital form.
